# Live domain: set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in .env.local

# 2) https://YOUR-DOMAIN/sitemap.xml
#
# robots.txt and sitemap.xml are generated by Next.js:
#   /robots.txt  -> src/app/robots.ts
#   /sitemap.xml -> src/app/sitemap.ts
